notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
You control a Food.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {3}.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
